blurb: Carriage Gate Morgans offers horseback riding and carriage driving lessons for all ages and experience levels, as well as horse boarding services. The atmosphere is quiet and non-competitive, focusing on equine and rider safety, enjoyment, and learning. The farm hosts a variety of disciplines such as dressage, western, trail, carriage and pleasure driving.
